workbuddy-task-dispatch.title: WorkBuddy cloud execution
workbuddy-task-dispatch.intro: Choose an account you have authorized for this project, preview the fixed content, then confirm dispatch.
workbuddy-task-dispatch.scope_hint: Only your authorization for the current project is used.
workbuddy-task-dispatch.model_boundary: The provider manages the model. Usage and costs are unverified, and platform hard budget limits are not guaranteed.
workbuddy-task-dispatch.delivery_boundar: Provider completion still requires trusted code delivery, independent testing, and human acceptance.
workbuddy-task-dispatch.no_accounts: You have no authorized accounts here.
workbuddy-task-dispatch.no_eligible_acco: The loaded accounts are not currently eligible for dispatch. Check their authorization, scopes, and expiry.
workbuddy-task-dispatch.plan_invalid: This plan cannot be used for a new dispatch. Create a new preview.
workbuddy-task-dispatch.plan_expired: This plan has expired. Create a new preview.
workbuddy-task-dispatch.source_changed: The task has changed. Reload it before previewing.
workbuddy-task-dispatch.baseline_hint: This path does not yet support tasks bound to a code baseline. The existing local development flow remains available.
workbuddy-task-dispatch.original_preview: The original preview result is unconfirmed. Recover the original operation before continuing.
workbuddy-task-dispatch.original_start_p: The original dispatch result is unconfirmed. Check the original operation to avoid creating a duplicate run.
workbuddy-task-dispatch.original_confirm: The original operation is confirmed. Reloaded content determines the current state.
workbuddy-task-dispatch.no_test_plan: No published test plan is linked. Formal test evidence is still required after cloud execution completes.
workbuddy-task-dispatch.knowledge_intro: Only explicitly selected published revisions are attached.
workbuddy-task-dispatch.knowledge_empty: No published knowledge is currently available to select.
workbuddy-task-dispatch.knowledge_change: The selected knowledge has changed. Select the current published revisions again.
workbuddy-task-dispatch.invalid_read: The returned content does not match the current account, project, or task. Reload it.
workbuddy-task-dispatch.refresh_failed: The current content could not be confirmed.
workbuddy-task-dispatch.access_changed: Your access has changed. Protected execution content has been cleared.
workbuddy-task-dispatch.max_version: The current content has reached its version limit. Contact an administrator.
